bio: Come indulge your senses at La Bibliotheque with their Japanese Tapas Style Afternoon Tea, which offers an exciting and creative twist of Japanese and Mediterranean flavours.  Complete your experience with a carefully selected range of premium tea’s, including Japanese varieties, as well as a wide selection of sakes and cocktails.  La Bibliothèque is a restaurant that blends modern luxury with a touch of East London charm, with a sake bar and whisky library. Every aspect of La Bibliothèque has been thoughtfully curated and designed to offer guests a unique, immersive and truly unforgettable experience.  The selection of savoury and sweet bites are all made fresh daily by their chef’s team. Enjoy the likes of a Peanut Tart, Dark Chocolate Crémeux, Miso Salted Caramel,  Sweet Potato Moshi, Crushed Avocado, Pickled Ginger and many many more.  Guest can enjoy their Afternoon Tea with a glass of sparkling sake or Champagne. There is also the option to enjoy unlimited cocktails and prosecco for 90 minutes. A curated cocktail menu will be available, featuring creative cocktails using premium spirits and homemade ingredients such as Japanese gins and many more.
